fullLibrary.name: UNO®
fullLibrary.trophyTitleDetail: It's a race to the finish as you try to empty your hand before everyone else. Play with friends and family the way you want to play with an assortment of House Rules as well as, for the first time, Themes with updated visuals and never-before-seen Theme Cards that introduce crazy effects and powers to the game. It's the UNO you know and love--and so much more!

fullLibrary.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III
fullLibrary.trophyTitleName: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III
fullLibrary.trophyTitleDetail: Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 deploys its players into a future where bio-technology has enabled a new breed of Black Ops soldier. Players are now always on and always connected to the intelligence grid and their fellow operatives during battle. In a world more divided than ever, this elite squad consists of men and women who have enhanced their combat capabilities to fight faster, stronger, and smarter. Every soldier has to make difficult decisions and visit dark places in this engaging, gritty narrative.

fullLibrary.name: Wheel of Fortune®
fullLibrary.trophyTitleDetail:
American's Game - Wheel of Fortune® comes to the PlayStation®4 computer entertainment system with HD graphics for the first time!
-Enjoy thousands of unique puzzles which stay true to the original TV Show. 
-Compete with your friends and family online and try to reach the top of the leaderboards.
-Progress through the game by unlocking all the rewards, leveling up and collecting all the souvenirs.
Wheel of Fortune offers both the original TV show‘s DNA as well as unique and new features for both veteran players and new players alike.
